decisions.reason: The gold-medal premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship seasonal product and a key driver of revenue and reputation.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits established demand, shares production with the core rye range and survived the 2024 range pruning.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche traditional variety with low incremental cost, though it remains the most likely candidate if the bread range is pruned further.
The marzipan stollen is a classic seasonal gift item that complements the flagship stollen line at little extra cost.
